hyperedges.label: Duplicate AI UI Implementations (SPA vs Side Panel)
Mask Editor One Inpainting Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Full ComfyUI inpainting workflow: an SDXL-family checkpoint (hayochamixIDXL_v11) supplies MODEL/CLIP/VAE; the custom 'Mask Editor One' node (comfyui-mask-editor-one) loads a source image and lets the user paint/edit a mask (with invert and blur_radius options), outputting image + mask; these feed VAE Encode (for Inpainting) along with two CLIP Text Encode prompt nodes (positive/negative); KSampler denoises the inpaint latent (ddim sampler, simple scheduler, 30 steps, cfg 4.0, denoise 1.0); VAE Decode converts the result back to pixel space; Save Image writes the final output.

nodes.label: ImpactWildcardEncode Validation Fix
nodes.rationale: ImpactWildcardEncode nodes carry dynamic placeholder COMBO values (e.g. 'Select Wildcard Full Cache') not present in /object_info's option list, causing ComfyUI prompt validation to fail; fixed by falling back to the first valid choice when the widget value isn't in the current option list, and by tracking per-node-type text field keys (wildcard_text vs text) via a data-text-key attribute instead of assuming a fixed 'text' field.

nodes.label: Impact Pack Symlink Integration
nodes.rationale: Windows junctions cannot be detected via os.path.islink(), so a custom _is_junction() check using GetFileAttributesW + FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT is required before deciding whether to skip directory creation or migrate existing wildcard files.

nodes.label: ComfyUI App Mode (linearMode) Investigation
nodes.rationale: ComfyUI's App mode (BETA) stores extra.linearMode=true and extra.linearData (inputs/outputs arrays) in the workflow JSON, and the .app.json extension is retained even after linearData is cleared to empty arrays. Because App mode itself is still BETA, badge-display support for it was deliberately deferred rather than implemented.

nodes.label: Data Storage Relocation to user/default
nodes.rationale: Plugin data moved from custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Workflow-Studio/data/ to ComfyUI/user/default/Workflow-Studio/ so plugin data survives custom-node reinstalls/updates; falls back to the old data/ path when user/default/ doesn't exist (Portable/Docker setups), preserving backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Theme Customizer (Color/Pattern/Font)
nodes.rationale: SVG background patterns are recolored by injecting a <style> block rather than only replacing fill/stroke attributes, to also cover SVGs that rely on CSS classes or default black. Gap spacing between tiled SVG patterns is produced with a wrapper SVG whose viewBox is expanded. Google Fonts load dynamically via injected <link> tags, tracked in a Set to avoid duplicate loads. Accordion sections use native <details>/<summary> so no JS is needed for open/close behavior.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Batch Generation
nodes.rationale: Evolved from simple comma-separated include/exclude folder text filters (v0.3.2) to a checkbox-driven folder-tree dropdown with All/None and search (later revision), because plain text filters didn't scale to browsing many checkpoint subfolders. Added Pause/Resume via a Promise-based wait gate (_waitIfPaused/_resumeResolve) alongside the existing Stop/interrupt path so a running batch can be paused without losing progress.

nodes.label: Top Bar Icon MutationObserver Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause: ComfyUI's Vue framework re-renders the actionbar container and reverts injected SVG icons back to the original <i class=icon-...> markup, so a one-shot requestAnimationFrame injection wasn't durable. Fixed by watching the button's parent container (.actionbar-container) with a MutationObserver and re-injecting the SVG on every DOM mutation, guarded by a skip-if-already-has-SVG check to prevent an infinite loop.

nodes.label: Path Traversal Vulnerability Fix
nodes.rationale: Triggered by an external code review from ltdrdata (ComfyUI-Manager maintainer) on PR #2706, who flagged that import_files built file paths from a user-supplied original_name without sanitization, allowing path traversal (e.g. ../../etc/passwd) outside workflows_dir. Fixed by centralizing all path construction through a new _safe_path() method that validates the filename (rejecting '.', '..', null bytes) and confirms the resolved path stays under workflows_dir.

nodes.label: Project Rename to ComfyUI-Workflow-Studio
nodes.rationale: Renamed from ComfyUI-Workflow-Manager because it collided with an existing project name (yichengup's ComfyUI-WorkflowManager), ahead of GitHub publication and ComfyUI Manager registry submission.

nodes.label: Canvas Sidepanel Category/Package Subtabs & Theme
nodes.rationale: python_module (needed for accurate package badges) is absent from LiteGraph.registered_node_types, a frontend-only registry, so /object_info is fetched in parallel during loadData() for correct package attribution. Panel theme colors are applied via inline style.setProperty scoped to the panel element only, avoiding overwriting ComfyUI's global :root CSS variables. Category/Package filter dropdowns are inserted/removed via DOM insertBefore on every renderContent() call, centralizing cleanup when switching tabs.

nodes.label: Gallery Folder/File Management
nodes.rationale: Tree-expansion state is preserved across rebuilds via a Set of expanded folder paths rather than DOM diffing, since it is simpler and tolerates folder add/delete changing the tree shape. PNG metadata is read with fallback priority: embedded 'workflow' key, then embedded 'prompt' key, then gallery_metadata.json — because ComfyUI's SaveImage node embeds only the API-format 'prompt' key by default, so referencing 'prompt' covers ordinary ComfyUI-generated images.

nodes.label: Gallery Tab Phase 1
nodes.rationale: os.scandir() plus a folder cache were used specifically to keep browsing responsive against an environment with 6800+ images.

nodes.label: Group UI Unification Across Tabs
nodes.rationale: Workflow, Nodes, and Gallery tab group-management panels were rewritten to match the Models tab's existing 4-section pattern (Current Groups / Add to Group / Create New Group / Manage Groups) instead of maintaining separate divergent implementations per tab.

nodes.label: Model Enable/Disable & Bulk Delete
nodes.rationale: Disabling a model renames it with a '.disabled' suffix instead of moving/deleting the file, because ComfyUI only enumerates recognized extensions at scan time — the simplest way to hide a model without a separate DB. Selection-mode toggling updates the DOM directly via querySelectorAll + classList.toggle instead of re-rendering the whole grid, avoiding heavy re-renders. A stem-computation bug was traced to Path.stem stripping only the last suffix (so 'model.safetensors.disabled' incorrectly yielded stem 'model.safetensors'); fixed by stripping '.disabled' before computing the stem.

nodes.label: Models Tab & CivitAI Integration
nodes.rationale: Preview-image existence is checked with an img.onload/onerror pattern rather than a HEAD request, to avoid 404 console spam. Bulk CivitAI metadata fetch streams progress via Server-Sent Events instead of one blocking request, for real-time progress display. aiohttp's add_get auto-registers a matching HEAD route, so an explicit HEAD handler was omitted to avoid a duplicate-route RuntimeError.

hyperedges.label: Duplicate AI UI Implementations (SPA vs Side Panel)
Mask Editor One Inpainting Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Full ComfyUI inpainting workflow: an SDXL-family checkpoint (hayochamixIDXL_v11) supplies MODEL/CLIP/VAE; the custom 'Mask Editor One' node (comfyui-mask-editor-one) loads a source image and lets the user paint/edit a mask (with invert and blur_radius options), outputting image + mask; these feed VAE Encode (for Inpainting) along with two CLIP Text Encode prompt nodes (positive/negative); KSampler denoises the inpaint latent (ddim sampler, simple scheduler, 30 steps, cfg 4.0, denoise 1.0); VAE Decode converts the result back to pixel space; Save Image writes the final output.
